name: gitlimiter
description: Nudges you (with sound and bad jokes) to open a PR while it's still small enough to review. Limits files and lines per file, with a status bar meter.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Git Limiter runs git in your project folder, so it needs a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Git Limiter needs a real folder on disk with a git repository.

commands.title: Raise Limits for This Branch (+40%, then +30%, +20%, +10%)

gitlimiter.maxFiles.description: Alert when your branch has changed this many files compared to the base branch (commits + uncommitted + untracked). 0 turns it off.

gitlimiter.maxLines.description: Alert when any single file on your branch has this many changed lines (added + removed) compared to the base branch. 0 turns it off.

gitlimiter.warnAtPercent.description: Turn the status bar yellow at this percentage of a limit. 0 turns it off.

gitlimiter.playSound.description: Play a sound when a limit is reached.

gitlimiter.soundRepeat.description: How many times the alert sound plays in a row. Raise it for a longer alert.

gitlimiter.soundFile.description: Custom sound file to play instead of the system sound (.aiff/.mp3/.wav on macOS, .wav on Windows, .wav/.oga on Linux).

gitlimiter.baseBranch.description: Branch your PRs target, e.g. origin/develop. Leave empty to detect it automatically (origin's default branch, then origin/main, origin/master, main, master).

gitlimiter.alertImage.description: Picture (.png, .gif, .jpg, .webp or .svg) shown in the alert details panel. Use a full path, ~ works. Leave empty for the built-in picture.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Git Limiter
walkthroughs.description: A 2-minute tour. No git knowledge needed.

steps.title: Watch the status bar
steps.description: Look at the bottom-left of VS Code. You will see ✅ PR size OK. It turns 👀 yellow, then 🚨 red as your branch grows.

steps.title: Hear what the alert sounds like
steps.description:
Try the alert now, so it never surprises you later.
[Test the alert](command:gitlimiter.testAlert)

steps.title: Pick your own limits
steps.description:
Choose how big is too big.
[Set limits](command:gitlimiter.setLimits)

steps.title: Open a PR when it nags you
steps.description:
Click Open PR 🚀 on the alert.
[Open Pull Request](command:gitlimiter.openPullRequest)
